definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 splits 'character' into four senses (4.26 a code value of a coded character set, 4.27 a graphic character in a screen item, 4.28 a COBOL character, 4.29 a single code value in storage); 2023 drops those entries but keeps each sense under its own term (§2023:3.7 alphanumeric character, national character, §2023:3.93 graphic character, §2023:3.37 COBOL character repertoire), so the drop is of a heading, not of a meaning. The hexadecimal digits are COBOL characters (4.28, = §2023:3.37) and each digit pair denotes one code value (4.29); the same units at both editions.
